verdict.rationale: Agent Checkouts has a poll-driven lifecycle where the agent polls the checkout until it reaches a terminal state ('no webhooks in v1'). Order intents track total, reserved, spent and available amounts, and the general Checkout product offers order-lifecycle and payment-status webhooks. Post-purchase fulfillment or shipment tracking for orders an agent placed at arbitrary merchants is not evidenced. Missing for 10: carrier/shipment tracking data, post-terminal order status retrieval for agent checkouts, webhooks for agent checkouts, independent hands-on corroboration.
